en-US.name: Luma Doorbell Alert
en-US.summary: Flash your chosen Govee lights through Luma when a routine runs.
en-US.description: A private smart home skill for your own Luma relay. It adds one scene, Doorbell Alert, that you can run from an Alexa routine such as When the doorbell is pressed.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Private skill for the developer's own home.
